caption: The image shows a metallic model of a steam locomotive or toy train engine. The locomotive is constructed with cylindrical and rectangular shapes for the main body and the cab, respectively; the cab has a roof with three arched windows on the visible side and is positioned at the back. The locomotive has four large spoked wheels and two smaller wheels at the front, all of which are thin and also appear to be made of metal. The surface of the locomotive shows signs of paint wear, revealing patches of lighter and darker areas, suggesting it was originally covered in dark paint. The front of the locomotive features a cowcatcher, which is a triangular, slatted piece extending downward. There are details on the top, including a prominent smokestack at the front, topped with a wide rim, and a smaller dome-shaped detail behind it. There are additional elements such as vertical cylinders near the front, wire loops attached to the body, and a small bird or winged figurine affixed to one of the upright cylinders. The image is in black-and-white, and the composition has the train angled slightly to the left, casting reflections and shadows on the surface beneath it.
title: Toy Locomotive
